Ronaldo, who wore the number and went on to make it his own as “CR7,” retired from international soccer last week, ending a remarkable career that spanned six World Cups, a European title, and the men’s all-time international scoring record. “Time to debut a new 7. Because there’s one that will be eternal,” the Portuguese national team wrote on social media on Saturday. The post included a goat emoji to signify “Greatest Of All Time.”

news.title: Luca Zidane Dropped from Algeria Squad for AFCON Qualifiers
news.og_title: Luca Zidane Dropped from Algeria Squad for AFCON Qualifiers
news.og_desc: Algeria goalkeeper Luca Zidane was left out of the national team squad on Thursday ahead of two Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers against Togo, coach Brahim Hemdani said. Zidane, 28, has recently been missing from the Algerian team, owing to injury and a two-game suspension over scuffles during an AFCON game against Nigeria in January. But his exclusion was "based on sporting criteria", Hemdani told journalists, according to AFP. "I need to have three goalkeepers who were getting as much playing time as possible."
